title: Stripe acquires AI startup OpenRouter for over $7 billion
summary: Payments platform Stripe buys OpenRouter, an AI model gateway, in a deal valued at over $7 billion.

title: Steam Deck LCD replacement battery jumps 125% to $180
summary: The price of the official battery for the Steam Deck LCD version soars to €179.95 ($180), more than double its previous cost.

title: AMD bans Radeon RX 9050 reviews and leaks show it performs worse than a 2022 RX 6650 XT
summary: AMD blocked the sending of review samples and an independent review confirms the new entry-level GPU is slower than a card from three years ago.

title: Manufacturers warn entry-level graphics card shortage will worsen in second half of 2026
summary: ZOTAC, Inno3D, and Manli warn that basic GPU supply will deteriorate further in the coming months.
